metadata.name: Iron Compound
metadata.author: Tile Trigger
metadata.description: A walled military compound facing a trench line (Style Pack 01: Military Compound). The garrison holds the barracks, command bunker, armoury and two guard towers with mounted guns; the raiders come over the top from the trenches. The main gate is a blast door worked from a button, with alarm lights; the north gate opens for anyone; concrete barriers and gabions break under fire.
